caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular quilt with nine identical floral motifs arranged in a 3x3 grid on a light-colored background. Each motif features a central red flower with a yellow center and yellow-tipped petals, surrounded by a semicircle of green leaves and red buds. The semicircles are oriented with their open ends facing inward, and the leaves alternate in their direction along the arch. The motifs are evenly spaced, and the background features a faint, swirling, textured pattern around each motif. The entire composition is outlined with a single yellow border along the left, top, and part of the right edge, while the bottom and remainder of the right edge are bordered by blue. The artist's signature, "Frank [illegible] Quilting," is faintly visible in the lower right corner.
title: Cotton Quilt - Tulip Design
